title: One Planet Is Turning
about: It is printed in Rainbow AU songs (“on her course around the sun”). Staff notation appears in Butterfly Bill — Rainbow Chants, p.5. It is a close relative of Charlie Murphy’s “Light Is Returning”.
melody_note: Encoded from Butterfly Bill's RainbowChants.pdf p.5 (bliss-fire.com) — typeset lead sheet, three verses under one melody, “E minor is played throughout on the Rainbow Spirit video.” Some long notes are tied across systems; rhythm of the “a-round the” figure is a draft reading — verify.
verdict: Verdict: pending. IDENTITY NOTE: these are the verses of Charlie Murphy's “Light Is Returning” (verse 2 here IS “Light is returning, even tho this is the darkest hour”) — the same song family as rank 44 “Returning of the Light”. This bears directly on the open rank-44 identity decision.
